name: Pagination
label: Pagination
description: Numbered page navigation for long datasets, with ellipses, disabled end arrows, and a compact readout mode.

props.name: page
props.description:
Current page (1-based), for a controlled pager. Leave it undefined to let
the component keep its own page, seeded from `defaultPage`.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Page shown on first render when the pager is uncontrolled (1-based)

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the page the user requests

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page

props.name: size
props.description: Component size — compact swaps the numbers for a "Page X of Y" readout

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Legacy accessible-name prop for the nav landmark.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous-page arrow

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next-page arrow

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a numbered page button, given its page number

props.name: readoutLabel
props.description: Text of the compact size's readout, given the current page and the page count

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the page numbers is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.
